spec.note: Limited supply of funded accounts: at most N passes per calendar month, each paid when it passes, spares dormant on a shelf that counts toward the 20-account cap. Replacement policy across every shelf; weekly-one and monthly-one without spares as comparators. Coarse headroom grid plus refinement around each product's best bundle, applied to both products.

legacy_25k.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.
